people.name: Homer
people.known_for: Legendary Greek poet credited with the Iliad and the Odyssey.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊传说中的盲诗人，相传创作了《伊利亚特》和《奥德赛》两部史诗。

people.name: Lycurgus
people.known_for: Semi-legendary lawgiver said to have created Sparta's military society.
people.known_for_zh: 半传说中的斯巴达立法者，相传奠定了斯巴达的军事化社会制度。

check.n: Legendary figure; dates are traditional and vary widely (Wikidata c. 800-730 BC).
check.n_zh: 传说人物，年代为传统说法且分歧很大（维基数据作约前800至前730年）。

Rome.name: Romulus
Rome.note_zh: 传说中的罗马城建立者。

Rome.name: Lucius Tarquinius Superbus
Rome.note: Expelled in 509 BC, when Rome became a republic.
Rome.note_zh: 公元前509年被驱逐，罗马进入共和时代。

Athens.name: Peisistratos
Athens.note: Seized power three times, ruling continuously from about 546 BC.
Athens.note_zh: 三度夺权，约自公元前546年起稳定统治。

Athens.name: Hippias
Athens.note: Expelled in 510 BC; Cleisthenes' reforms followed.
Athens.note_zh: 公元前510年被逐，随后克利斯提尼推行改革。

people.name: Hesiod
people.known_for: Greek poet of farming life and of the origins of the gods.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊诗人，作品描写农事生活和诸神的起源谱系。

people.name: Sappho
people.known_for: Lyric poet of Lesbos, admired in antiquity as the tenth Muse.
people.known_for_zh: 莱斯沃斯岛的抒情女诗人，古人称她为“第十位缪斯”。

people.name: Thales
people.known_for: Often called the first Greek philosopher; held that everything comes from water.
people.known_for_zh: 常被称为第一位希腊哲学家，认为万物的本原是水。

people.name: Anaximander
people.known_for: Milesian philosopher who drew an early world map and spoke of the boundless (apeiron).
people.known_for_zh: 米利都学派哲学家，提出“无限者”为万物本原，绘制了早期世界地图。

people.name: Solon
people.known_for: Athenian lawgiver who cancelled debts and laid the base for democracy.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典立法者，废除债务奴役，为雅典民主奠定了基础。

people.name: Draco
people.known_for: Gave Athens its first written laws, famous for their harshness.
people.known_for_zh: 为雅典制定第一部成文法，以严苛著称。

people.name: Aesop
people.known_for: Teller of fables, traditionally said to be a slave on Samos.
people.known_for_zh: 相传为萨摩斯岛的奴隶，以讲述寓言闻名。

people.name: Pythagoras
people.known_for: Philosopher and mathematician who taught that number underlies all things.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家和数学家，认为“万物皆数”，在克罗顿创立学派。

people.name: Anacreon
people.known_for: Lyric poet of wine and love.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊抒情诗人，以歌咏美酒与爱情著称。

people.name: Cleisthenes
people.known_for: Reformed Athens in 508 BC and is called the father of Athenian democracy.
people.known_for_zh: 公元前508年改革雅典政制，被称为“雅典民主之父”。

people.name: Heraclitus
people.known_for: Philosopher of change who said that one cannot step into the same river twice.
people.known_for_zh: 以弗所哲学家，强调万物流变，提出“人不能两次踏进同一条河流”。

Macedon.name: Philip II
Macedon.note: Won control of Greece at Chaeronea in 338 BC.
Macedon.note_zh: 公元前338年喀罗尼亚之战后控制希腊。

Macedon.name: Alexander the Great
Macedon.note: Conquered the Persian Empire as far as India.
Macedon.note_zh: 征服波斯帝国，兵锋直抵印度。

Sparta.name: Cleomenes I
Sparta.note: Sparta always had two kings at once; notable ones are listed.
Sparta.note_zh: 斯巴达同时有两位国王，此处只列重要者。

Sparta.name: Leonidas I
Sparta.note_zh: 在温泉关抵抗波斯军队时战死。

people.name: Miltiades
people.known_for: Athenian general who won the Battle of Marathon in 490 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典将领，公元前490年在马拉松战役中击败波斯军队。

people.name: Themistocles
people.known_for: Built the Athenian navy and won the sea battle of Salamis.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典政治家，建立雅典海军，取得萨拉米斯海战的胜利。

people.name: Pericles
people.known_for: Led Athens in its golden age and built the Parthenon.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典黄金时代的领导人，主持修建帕特农神庙，推动民主政治。

people.name: Aeschylus
people.known_for: First of the great Athenian tragedians, called the father of tragedy.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典三大悲剧作家之首，被称为“悲剧之父”。

people.name: Sophocles
people.known_for: Tragedian whose Oedipus the King was held a model by Aristotle.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典悲剧作家，代表作《俄狄浦斯王》被亚里士多德奉为典范。

people.name: Euripides
people.known_for: Tragedian known for realistic characters and strong women.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典悲剧作家，作品人物真实，常以女性为主角。

people.name: Aristophanes
people.known_for: Master of Old Comedy who mocked the politicians of Athens.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊喜剧大师，作品讽刺雅典政治人物，被称为“喜剧之父”。

people.name: Pindar
people.known_for: Lyric poet famed for odes to athletic victors.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊抒情诗人，以歌颂竞技胜利者的颂歌闻名。

people.name: Herodotus
people.known_for: Wrote the history of the Greco-Persian Wars and is called the father of history.
people.known_for_zh: 记述希波战争的史家，被称为“历史之父”。

people.name: Thucydides
people.known_for: Athenian general who wrote a critical history of the Peloponnesian War.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典将军，以严谨的态度写成伯罗奔尼撒战争的历史。

people.name: Phidias
people.known_for: Sculptor who oversaw the Parthenon and made the statue of Zeus at Olympia.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊雕刻家，主持帕特农神庙雕刻，作有奥林匹亚宙斯像。

people.name: Polykleitos
people.known_for: Sculptor who set out ideal human proportions in his Canon.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊雕刻家，以《法则》阐述人体理想比例，代表作《持矛者》。

people.name: Praxiteles
people.known_for: Sculptor of graceful gods, including the Aphrodite of Knidos.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊雕刻家，作品优雅柔美，代表作《尼多斯的阿佛洛狄忒》。

people.name: Parmenides
people.known_for: Founder of the Eleatic school, who argued that being is one and unchanging.
people.known_for_zh: 埃利亚学派创始人，认为存在是唯一而不变的。

people.name: Zeno of Elea
people.known_for: Known for paradoxes such as Achilles and the tortoise.
people.known_for_zh: 埃利亚学派哲学家，以“阿基里斯追乌龟”等悖论著称。

people.name: Empedocles
people.known_for: Taught that all things are made of four elements: earth, water, air and fire.
people.known_for_zh: 提出万物由土、水、气、火四种元素组成。

people.name: Anaxagoras
people.known_for: Brought philosophy to Athens and taught that mind orders the cosmos.
people.known_for_zh: 把哲学带到雅典，认为“努斯”（心灵）安排宇宙秩序。

people.name: Protagoras
people.known_for: Leading sophist who said that man is the measure of all things.
people.known_for_zh: 著名智者，提出“人是万物的尺度”。

people.name: Democritus
people.known_for: Taught that the world is made of atoms moving in the void.
people.known_for_zh: 原子论的代表人物，认为万物由原子和虚空构成。

people.name: Hippocrates
people.known_for: Physician who treated disease as natural, called the father of medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 古希腊医生，主张疾病有自然原因，被称为“医学之父”。

people.name: Socrates
people.known_for: Athenian philosopher who taught by questioning and was put to death in 399 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典哲学家，以问答法探讨伦理，公元前399年被判处死刑。

people.name: Plato
people.known_for: Pupil of Socrates who founded the Academy and wrote philosophical dialogues.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格拉底的学生，创办阿卡德米学园，著有大量对话体哲学著作。

people.name: Aristotle
people.known_for: Pupil of Plato and teacher of Alexander, who wrote on almost every field of knowledge.
people.known_for_zh: 柏拉图的学生、亚历山大的老师，著述涉及几乎所有学科。

people.name: Xenophon
people.known_for: Soldier and writer who led the Ten Thousand home from Persia.
people.known_for_zh: 军人和作家，曾率希腊雇佣军从波斯腹地撤回。

people.name: Diogenes
people.known_for: Cynic philosopher who lived in a large jar and scorned convention.
people.known_for_zh: 犬儒学派哲学家，住在大陶缸里，蔑视世俗礼法。

people.name: Demosthenes
people.known_for: Greatest Athenian orator, who urged resistance to Philip II of Macedon.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典最伟大的演说家，号召雅典人反抗马其顿的腓力二世。

people.name: Cincinnatus
people.known_for: Roman farmer who became dictator to save Rome and then returned to his plough.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马农夫，临危出任独裁官，解围后即辞职归田，被视为公民美德典范。

Macedon and Hellenic League.name: Alexander IV
Macedon and Hellenic League.note: Infant son of Alexander; the generals held power.
Macedon and Hellenic League.note_zh: 亚历山大的遗腹子，实权在部将手中。

Macedon and Hellenic League.name: Antigonus II Gonatas
Macedon and Hellenic League.note_zh: 巩固了安提柯王朝的统治。

Macedon and Hellenic League.name: Philip V
Macedon and Hellenic League.note: Defeated by Rome at Cynoscephalae in 197 BC.
Macedon and Hellenic League.note_zh: 公元前197年在库诺斯克法莱战役中被罗马击败。

Macedon and Hellenic League.name: Perseus
Macedon and Hellenic League.note: Last king; defeated by Rome at Pydna in 168 BC.
Macedon and Hellenic League.note_zh: 末代国王，公元前168年皮德纳战役败于罗马。

Syracuse.name: Hiero II
Syracuse.note: Ally of Rome and patron of Archimedes.
Syracuse.note_zh: 罗马的盟友，阿基米德的保护人。

people.name: Euclid
people.known_for: Mathematician whose Elements was the standard geometry textbook for two thousand years.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，所著《几何原本》作为几何教科书沿用了两千年。

people.name: Archimedes
people.known_for: Mathematician and engineer who found the law of buoyancy and the lever.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家和工程师，发现浮力定律和杠杆原理，死于罗马攻陷叙拉古时。

people.name: Eratosthenes
people.known_for: Librarian of Alexandria who measured the circumference of the Earth.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大图书馆馆长，首次较准确地测量了地球周长。

people.name: Aristarchus of Samos
people.known_for: Astronomer who first proposed that the Earth goes round the Sun.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，最早提出地球绕太阳运行的日心说。

people.name: Apollonius of Perga
people.known_for: Geometer who named and studied the ellipse, parabola and hyperbola.
people.known_for_zh: 几何学家，系统研究并命名了椭圆、抛物线和双曲线。

people.name: Hipparchus
people.known_for: Astronomer who catalogued stars and discovered the precession of the equinoxes.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，编制星表并发现岁差，被誉为三角学的奠基人。

people.name: Herophilos
people.known_for: Physician who dissected human bodies and founded scientific anatomy.
people.known_for_zh: 医生，进行人体解剖，被视为解剖学的奠基人。

people.name: Theophrastus
people.known_for: Aristotle's successor at the Lyceum, called the father of botany.
people.known_for_zh: 亚里士多德在吕克昂学园的继承人，被称为“植物学之父”。

people.name: Epicurus
people.known_for: Founded a school teaching that a calm, simple life free of fear is the highest good.
people.known_for_zh: 在雅典创立“花园”学派，主张以宁静快乐为人生至善。

people.name: Zeno of Citium
people.known_for: Founder of Stoicism, which taught living in harmony with reason and nature.
people.known_for_zh: 斯多葛学派创始人，主张顺应理性与自然而生活。

people.name: Menander
people.known_for: Leading writer of Greek New Comedy about everyday family life.
people.known_for_zh: 希腊新喜剧的代表作家，作品描写日常家庭生活。

people.name: Callimachus
people.known_for: Poet and scholar who catalogued the Library of Alexandria.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和学者，为亚历山大图书馆编制了书目。

people.name: Theocritus
people.known_for: Poet who created the pastoral (bucolic) poem.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，开创了西方田园诗的传统。

people.name: Pyrrhus of Epirus
people.known_for: King of Epirus whose costly victories over Rome gave us the phrase Pyrrhic victory.
people.known_for_zh: 伊庇鲁斯国王，对罗马的惨胜留下了“皮洛士式胜利”一词。

people.name: Hamilcar Barca
people.known_for: Carthaginian general in the First Punic War who built a power base in Spain.
people.known_for_zh: 第一次布匿战争中的迦太基将领，后在西班牙建立根据地。

people.name: Hannibal
people.known_for: Carthaginian general who crossed the Alps and won at Cannae in 216 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基统帅，率军翻越阿尔卑斯山，公元前216年坎尼会战大胜罗马。

people.name: Quintus Fabius Maximus
people.known_for: Roman dictator whose delaying tactics wore Hannibal down.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马独裁官，以拖延战术消耗汉尼拔，被称为“拖延者”。

people.name: Scipio Africanus
people.known_for: Roman general who defeated Hannibal at Zama in 202 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马统帅，公元前202年在扎马战役中击败汉尼拔。

people.name: Cato the Elder
people.known_for: Stern Roman censor who ended speeches with 'Carthage must be destroyed'.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马监察官，崇尚古风，常说“迦太基必须毁灭”。

people.name: Plautus
people.known_for: Roman comic playwright who adapted Greek comedies for Latin audiences.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马喜剧作家，改编希腊新喜剧，作品流传甚广。

people.name: Terence
people.known_for: Former slave from Africa who became a refined Roman comic playwright.
people.known_for_zh: 出身北非的被释奴隶，成为风格典雅的罗马喜剧作家。

people.name: Polybius
people.known_for: Greek historian of Rome's rise to world power.
people.known_for_zh: 希腊史家，记述罗马崛起为地中海霸主的过程，提出混合政体理论。

Roman Republic.name: Sulla
Roman Republic.note: The Republic was led by two consuls a year; only its strongmen are listed.
Roman Republic.note_zh: 共和国每年由两位执政官主政，此处只列掌握大权者。

Roman Republic.name: Julius Caesar
Roman Republic.note: Made dictator for life in 44 BC and murdered the same year.
Roman Republic.note_zh: 公元前44年成为终身独裁官，同年遇刺身亡。

Roman Republic.name: Octavian
Roman Republic.note: Shared power with Mark Antony and Lepidus, then won sole power at Actium in 31 BC.
Roman Republic.note_zh: 与安东尼、雷必达共掌大权，公元前31年亚克兴海战后独揽大权。

people.name: Tiberius Gracchus
people.known_for: Tribune who proposed land reform for the poor and was killed by senators.
people.known_for_zh: 保民官，提出土地改革以扶助贫民，被元老派杀害。

people.name: Gaius Gracchus
people.known_for: Brother of Tiberius who pushed wider reforms and died in the violence.
people.known_for_zh: 提比略的弟弟，推行更广泛的改革，在冲突中身亡。

people.name: Gaius Marius
people.known_for: Seven times consul who reformed the army into a professional force.
people.known_for_zh: 七度出任执政官，推行军事改革，建立职业化军队。

people.name: Spartacus
people.known_for: Thracian gladiator who led the great slave revolt of 73 to 71 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 色雷斯角斗士，领导了公元前73年至前71年的大规模奴隶起义。

people.name: Mithridates VI
people.known_for: King of Pontus who fought three wars against Rome.
people.known_for_zh: 本都国王，曾与罗马进行三次战争。

people.name: Pompey
people.known_for: General who conquered the East and lost the civil war to Caesar.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马统帅，平定东方，后在内战中败于恺撒。

people.name: Marcus Licinius Crassus
people.known_for: Richest man in Rome and member of the First Triumvirate.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马首富，前三头同盟成员，在卡莱战役中败于帕提亚而死。

people.name: Julius Caesar
people.known_for: Conquered Gaul, won the civil war and became dictator before his murder.
people.known_for_zh: 征服高卢，赢得内战成为独裁官，后被刺杀。

people.name: Cicero
people.known_for: Orator and statesman whose Latin prose became a model for later ages.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马演说家和政治家，其拉丁散文成为后世典范。

people.name: Cato the Younger
people.known_for: Stoic senator who opposed Caesar and took his own life rather than submit.
people.known_for_zh: 斯多葛派元老，坚决反对恺撒，最终宁死不屈。

people.name: Vercingetorix
people.known_for: Gallic chief who led the revolt against Caesar and surrendered at Alesia.
people.known_for_zh: 高卢首领，领导反抗恺撒的起义，在阿莱西亚投降。

people.name: Marcus Junius Brutus
people.known_for: Senator who led the plot to murder Caesar.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马元老，刺杀恺撒的主要策划者之一。

people.name: Mark Antony
people.known_for: Caesar's ally who shared power with Octavian and allied with Cleopatra.
people.known_for_zh: 恺撒的部将，与屋大维共掌大权，后与克利奥帕特拉结盟。

people.name: Cleopatra
people.known_for: Last ruler of Ptolemaic Egypt, ally of Caesar and Antony.
people.known_for_zh: 托勒密埃及的末代女王，与恺撒和安东尼结盟。

people.name: Lucretius
people.known_for: Poet who set out Epicurean atomism in verse.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马诗人，以长诗阐述伊壁鸠鲁的原子论。

people.name: Catullus
people.known_for: Lyric poet of love and wit, famous for his poems to Lesbia.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马抒情诗人，以写给“莱斯比娅”的爱情诗闻名。

people.name: Sallust
people.known_for: Historian of the Catiline conspiracy and the war with Jugurtha.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马史家，著有喀提林阴谋和朱古达战争的历史。

people.name: Varro
people.known_for: The most learned Roman of his age, writing on language, farming and antiquities.
people.known_for_zh: 当时最博学的罗马学者，著述涉及语言、农业和古代制度。

people.name: Posidonius
people.known_for: Stoic philosopher and scientist in Rhodes who taught Cicero.
people.known_for_zh: 罗得岛的斯多葛派哲学家和科学家，西塞罗曾向他求学。

Roman Empire.name: Augustus
Roman Empire.note: Octavian, given the title Augustus in 27 BC.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 即屋大维，公元前27年获“奥古斯都”称号。

Roman Empire.name: Nerva
Roman Empire.note: First of the Five Good Emperors.

Roman Empire.name: Trajan
Roman Empire.note: The empire reached its greatest extent.

Roman Empire.name: Marcus Aurelius
Roman Empire.note_zh: 169年前与卢基乌斯·维鲁斯共治。

Roman Empire.name: Caracalla
Roman Empire.note: Gave citizenship to all free men of the empire in 212.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 212年授予帝国全体自由民公民权。

people.name: Agrippa
people.known_for: Augustus' general who won at Actium and built the first Pantheon.
people.known_for_zh: 屋大维的得力将领，赢得亚克兴海战，主持修建最早的万神殿。

people.name: Virgil
people.known_for: Poet of the Aeneid, Rome's national epic.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马诗人，所著《埃涅阿斯纪》被视为罗马民族史诗。

people.name: Horace
people.known_for: Lyric poet of the Augustan age and author of the Art of Poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 奥古斯都时代的抒情诗人，著有《诗艺》。

people.name: Ovid
people.known_for: Poet of the Metamorphoses, exiled by Augustus to the Black Sea.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马诗人，著有《变形记》，晚年被奥古斯都流放黑海之滨。

people.name: Livy
people.known_for: Wrote a huge history of Rome from its founding.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马史家，著有卷帙浩繁的《罗马史》（建城以来史）。

people.name: Vitruvius
people.known_for: Architect whose ten books are the only full architectural treatise surviving from antiquity.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马建筑师，所著《建筑十书》是唯一完整传世的古代建筑论著。

people.name: Strabo
people.known_for: Greek geographer who described the known world.
people.known_for_zh: 希腊地理学家，著有描述当时已知世界的《地理学》。

people.name: Arminius
people.known_for: Germanic chief who destroyed three Roman legions in the Teutoburg Forest in AD 9.
people.known_for_zh: 日耳曼首领，公元9年在条顿堡森林全歼三个罗马军团。

people.name: Paul the Apostle
people.known_for: Apostle who spread Christianity among the gentiles around the Mediterranean.
people.known_for_zh: 基督教使徒，在地中海各地向非犹太人传教，新约中多封书信出自其手。

people.name: Saint Peter
people.known_for: Leading apostle of Jesus, regarded by Catholics as the first pope.
people.known_for_zh: 耶稣的首席门徒，天主教视其为第一任教宗，相传殉道于罗马。

people.name: Seneca
people.known_for: Stoic philosopher and tutor of Nero, forced to kill himself.
people.known_for_zh: 斯多葛派哲学家，尼禄的老师，后被尼禄逼令自尽。

people.name: Boudica
people.known_for: Queen of the Iceni who led a revolt against Roman rule in Britain.
people.known_for_zh: 不列颠爱西尼部落女王，领导反抗罗马统治的起义。

people.name: Pliny the Elder
people.known_for: Author of the Natural History, killed at the eruption of Vesuvius.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马学者，著有百科全书式的《自然史》，死于维苏威火山爆发。

people.name: Josephus
people.known_for: Jewish historian of the war with Rome and the destruction of Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太史家，记述犹太战争和耶路撒冷的毁灭。

people.name: Quintilian
people.known_for: Teacher of rhetoric whose book on the training of the orator shaped education.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马修辞学家，所著《雄辩术原理》影响了后世教育。

people.name: Epictetus
people.known_for: Former slave and Stoic teacher who stressed what lies within our control.
people.known_for_zh: 出身奴隶的斯多葛派哲学家，强调区分“在我们控制之内”的事物。

people.name: Plutarch
people.known_for: Greek biographer who paired the lives of famous Greeks and Romans.
people.known_for_zh: 希腊传记作家，将希腊和罗马名人两两对照作传。

people.name: Tacitus
people.known_for: Senator and historian of the early emperors.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马元老和史家，记述早期帝国的历史，文笔犀利。

people.name: Pliny the Younger
people.known_for: Lawyer and letter writer who described the eruption of Vesuvius.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马律师和书信作家，记录了维苏威火山的爆发。

people.name: Juvenal
people.known_for: Satirist who coined the phrase 'bread and circuses'.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马讽刺诗人，留下“面包和马戏”的名句。

people.name: Suetonius
people.known_for: Biographer of Caesar and the first eleven emperors.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马传记作家，为恺撒和此后十一位皇帝立传。

people.name: Apollodorus of Damascus
people.name_zh: 大马士革的阿波罗多洛斯
people.known_for: Architect of Trajan's Forum and the bridge over the Danube.
people.known_for_zh: 图拉真时代的建筑师，设计了图拉真广场和多瑙河大桥。

people.name: Ptolemy
people.known_for: Astronomer whose Earth-centred system ruled astronomy until Copernicus.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家和地理学家，其地心说体系一直沿用到哥白尼时代。

people.name: Galen
people.known_for: Physician whose writings dominated Western medicine for over a thousand years.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马名医，其医学著作主导西方医学一千多年。

people.name: Marcus Aurelius
people.known_for: Philosopher emperor who wrote his Stoic reflections on campaign.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家皇帝，在征战途中写下斯多葛派的哲思录。

people.name: Tertullian
people.known_for: First major Christian author in Latin.
people.known_for_zh: 第一位用拉丁文写作的重要基督教神学家。

people.name: Ulpian
people.known_for: Jurist whose writings formed much of Justinian's Digest.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马法学家，其著述构成查士丁尼《学说汇纂》的主要部分。

Roman Empire.name: Severus Alexander
Roman Empire.note: His murder began the crisis of the third century.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 他被杀后帝国陷入“三世纪危机”。

Roman Empire.name: Maximinus Thrax
Roman Empire.name_zh: 马克西米努斯·色雷克斯

Roman Empire.name: Valerian
Roman Empire.note: Captured by the Persian king Shapur I.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 被波斯国王沙普尔一世俘虏。

Roman Empire.name: Diocletian
Roman Empire.note: Set up the Tetrarchy of four rulers.

Roman Empire.name: Constantine the Great
Roman Empire.note: Legalised Christianity and founded Constantinople in 330.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 使基督教合法化，330年建立君士坦丁堡。

Roman Empire.name: Julian
Roman Empire.note: Tried to restore the old gods.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 试图恢复传统多神教，史称“背教者”。

Roman Empire.name: Valens
Roman Empire.note: Killed by the Goths at Adrianople.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 在阿德里安堡战役中被哥特人杀死。

Roman Empire.name: Theodosius I
Roman Empire.note: Made Christianity the state religion; last ruler of the whole empire.
Roman Empire.note_zh: 定基督教为国教，最后一位统治整个帝国的皇帝。

Western Roman Empire.name: Romulus Augustulus
Western Roman Empire.name_zh: 罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯
Western Roman Empire.note: Deposed by Odoacer in 476, ending the Western Empire.
Western Roman Empire.note_zh: 476年被奥多亚克废黜，西罗马帝国灭亡。

Eastern Roman Empire.name: Theodosius II
Eastern Roman Empire.note: Built the land walls of Constantinople.
Eastern Roman Empire.note_zh: 修建君士坦丁堡的陆墙。

Hunnic Empire.name: Attila
Hunnic Empire.note: Ruled jointly with his brother Bleda until 445.

people.name: Plotinus
people.known_for: Founder of Neoplatonism, which taught that all comes from the One.
people.known_for_zh: 新柏拉图主义的创始人，认为万物源于“太一”。

people.name: Diophantus
people.known_for: Mathematician called the father of algebra.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，著有《算术》，被称为“代数学之父”。

people.name: Zenobia
people.known_for: Queen of Palmyra who broke away from Rome until Aurelian defeated her.
people.known_for_zh: 帕尔米拉女王，一度脱离罗马自立，后被奥勒良击败。

people.name: Eusebius
people.known_for: Bishop who wrote the first history of the Christian church.
people.known_for_zh: 凯撒利亚主教，写成第一部基督教会史，被称为“教会史之父”。

people.name: Arius
people.known_for: Priest whose view of Christ was condemned at the Council of Nicaea in 325.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大港的神父，其基督论在325年尼西亚公会议上被定为异端。

people.name: Athanasius
people.known_for: Bishop of Alexandria who defended the Nicene Creed against Arianism.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大港主教，坚决捍卫尼西亚信经、反对阿里乌派。

people.name: Wulfila
people.known_for: Bishop who converted the Goths and translated the Bible into Gothic.
people.known_for_zh: 向哥特人传教的主教，把《圣经》译成哥特文并为此创制字母。

people.name: Martin of Tours
people.known_for: Soldier turned bishop who spread monasticism in Gaul.
people.known_for_zh: 由士兵转为主教，在高卢推广修道生活，是法国的主保圣人。

people.name: Basil of Caesarea
people.known_for: Church Father whose rule shaped Eastern monasticism.
people.known_for_zh: 教父，所定会规奠定了东方修道制度的基础。

people.name: Ammianus Marcellinus
people.name_zh: 阿米阿努斯·马塞利努斯
people.known_for: Last great Roman historian, who described the Huns and Adrianople.
people.known_for_zh: 最后一位重要的罗马史家，记述了匈人和阿德里安堡战役。

people.name: Ambrose
people.known_for: Bishop of Milan who made Emperor Theodosius do penance.
people.known_for_zh: 米兰主教，曾令狄奥多西皇帝公开悔罪，四大拉丁教父之一。

people.name: Jerome
people.known_for: Translated the Bible into Latin, the version called the Vulgate.
people.known_for_zh: 将《圣经》译为拉丁文，即通俗拉丁文本《武加大译本》。

people.name: John Chrysostom
people.known_for: Archbishop of Constantinople famed for his preaching.
people.known_for_zh: 君士坦丁堡大主教，以雄辩的布道闻名，被称为“金口”。

people.name: Augustine of Hippo
people.known_for: Bishop of Hippo whose writings shaped Western Christian thought.
people.known_for_zh: 希波主教，其著作深刻影响了西方基督教思想。

people.name: Hypatia
people.known_for: Mathematician and philosopher of Alexandria, killed by a Christian mob.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大港的女数学家和哲学家，被基督徒暴民杀害。

people.name: Stilicho
people.known_for: Half-Vandal general who defended the Western Empire for Honorius.
people.known_for_zh: 具有汪达尔血统的将领，为霍诺留皇帝守卫西罗马帝国。

people.name: Alaric I
people.known_for: King of the Visigoths who sacked Rome in 410.
people.known_for_zh: 西哥特国王，410年攻陷并洗劫罗马城。

people.name: Saint Patrick
people.known_for: Missionary who brought Christianity to Ireland.
people.known_for_zh: 把基督教传入爱尔兰的传教士，被尊为爱尔兰的主保圣人。

people.name: Gaiseric
people.known_for: King of the Vandals who took Carthage and sacked Rome in 455.
people.known_for_zh: 汪达尔国王，夺取迦太基，455年洗劫罗马。

people.name: Flavius Aetius
people.known_for: Roman general who checked Attila at the Catalaunian Plains in 451.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马将领，451年在沙隆战役中击退阿提拉，被称为“最后的罗马人”。

Kingdom of Italy.name_zh: 意大利王国（奥多亚克与东哥特）

Frankish Kingdom.name: Clovis I
Frankish Kingdom.note: United the Franks and converted to Catholic Christianity.
Frankish Kingdom.note_zh: 统一法兰克人，皈依天主教，建立墨洛温王朝。

Frankish Kingdom.name: Chlothar I
Frankish Kingdom.note: Sole king of the Franks from 558.
Frankish Kingdom.note_zh: 558年起成为全体法兰克人的国王。

Frankish Kingdom.name: Dagobert I
Frankish Kingdom.note: Last strong Merovingian king; mayors of the palace held power after him.
Frankish Kingdom.note_zh: 最后一位有实权的墨洛温国王，此后宫相掌权。

Frankish Kingdom.name: Charles Martel
Frankish Kingdom.note: Ruled in the king's name and defeated the Umayyads at Tours in 732.
Frankish Kingdom.note_zh: 以宫相身份掌握实权，732年在普瓦捷（图尔）战役中击败阿拉伯军队。

Frankish Kingdom.name: Pepin the Short
Frankish Kingdom.note: First Carolingian king; gave the Pope lands in Italy.
Frankish Kingdom.note_zh: 加洛林王朝首位国王，“丕平献土”奠定了教皇国。

Frankish Kingdom.name: Charlemagne
Frankish Kingdom.note: Ruled with his brother Carloman I until 771; crowned emperor in 800.
Frankish Kingdom.note_zh: 771年前与弟弟卡洛曼共治，800年加冕称帝。

Eastern Roman Empire.name: Justinian I
Eastern Roman Empire.note: Reconquered Italy and North Africa, codified Roman law and built Hagia Sophia.
Eastern Roman Empire.note_zh: 收复意大利和北非，编纂《罗马民法大全》，修建圣索菲亚大教堂。

Eastern Roman Empire.name: Heraclius
Eastern Roman Empire.note: Defeated Persia but lost Syria and Egypt to the Arabs.
Eastern Roman Empire.note_zh: 击败波斯，但叙利亚和埃及被阿拉伯人夺去。

Eastern Roman Empire.name: Constantine IV
Eastern Roman Empire.note: Held Constantinople against the Arab siege using Greek fire.
Eastern Roman Empire.note_zh: 依靠“希腊火”击退阿拉伯人对君士坦丁堡的围攻。

Eastern Roman Empire.name: Justinian II
Eastern Roman Empire.note: Deposed, then ruled again from 705 to 711; six short reigns fill 695 to 717.
Eastern Roman Empire.note_zh: 被废黜后于705年至711年复位，695年至717年间另有数位短命皇帝。

Eastern Roman Empire.name: Leo III the Isaurian
Eastern Roman Empire.note: Repelled the Arab siege of 717 and began Iconoclasm.
Eastern Roman Empire.note_zh: 击退717年阿拉伯围城，发动“破坏圣像运动”。

Eastern Roman Empire.name: Irene
Eastern Roman Empire.note: First woman to rule the empire in her own name.
Eastern Roman Empire.note_zh: 第一位以自己名义统治帝国的女性。

Kingdom of Italy.name: Theodoric the Great
Kingdom of Italy.note_zh: 以拉韦纳为都城统治意大利。

people.name: Boethius
people.known_for: Roman philosopher who wrote the Consolation of Philosophy in prison before his execution.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马哲学家，被处死前在狱中写成《哲学的慰藉》。

people.name: Cassiodorus
people.known_for: Minister of Theodoric who founded a monastery to copy classical texts.
people.known_for_zh: 狄奥多里克的大臣，晚年建立修道院抄写古典文献。

people.name: Benedict of Nursia
people.known_for: Wrote the Rule of Saint Benedict, the basis of Western monastic life.
people.known_for_zh: 制定《本笃会规》，奠定了西方修道院制度的基础。

people.name: Belisarius
people.known_for: Justinian's general who reconquered North Africa and Italy.
people.known_for_zh: 查士丁尼的名将，收复了北非和意大利。

people.name: Theodora
people.known_for: Empress and partner in power of Justinian I.
people.known_for_zh: 查士丁尼一世的皇后，在政治上与皇帝共掌大权。

people.name: Tribonian
people.known_for: Jurist who led the compiling of Justinian's code of Roman law.
people.known_for_zh: 法学家，主持编纂查士丁尼的《罗马民法大全》。

people.name: Procopius
people.known_for: Historian of Justinian's wars and author of the scandalous Secret History.
people.known_for_zh: 记述查士丁尼战争的史家，另著有揭露宫廷的《秘史》。

people.name: Anthemius of Tralles
people.name_zh: 特拉勒斯的安提米乌斯
people.known_for: Mathematician and architect who designed Hagia Sophia.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家和建筑师，设计了圣索菲亚大教堂。

people.name: Gregory of Tours
people.known_for: Bishop who wrote the history of the Franks.
people.known_for_zh: 图尔主教，著有《法兰克人史》。

people.name: Columba
people.known_for: Irish monk who founded Iona and brought Christianity to Scotland.
people.known_for_zh: 爱尔兰修士，创建艾奥纳修道院，向苏格兰传教。

people.name: Gregory the Great
people.known_for: Pope who sent missionaries to England and strengthened the papacy.
people.known_for_zh: 教宗，派传教士到英格兰，加强了教宗权威。

people.name: Columbanus
people.known_for: Irish missionary who founded monasteries in Gaul and Italy.
people.known_for_zh: 爱尔兰传教士，在高卢和意大利建立多座修道院。

people.name: Isidore of Seville
people.known_for: Bishop who compiled the Etymologies, an encyclopedia used all through the Middle Ages.
people.known_for_zh: 塞维利亚主教，编纂百科全书《词源》，在整个中世纪广为使用。

people.name: Tariq ibn Ziyad
people.known_for: Umayyad commander who began the Muslim conquest of Spain in 711.
people.known_for_zh: 倭马亚王朝将领，711年开始征服西班牙，直布罗陀即以其名命名。

people.name: Pelagius of Asturias
people.known_for: Founder of the Kingdom of Asturias, whose win at Covadonga began the Reconquista.
people.known_for_zh: 阿斯图里亚斯王国的建立者，科瓦东加之战被视为“收复失地运动”的开端。

people.name: Bede
people.known_for: English monk who wrote the history of the English church and people.
people.known_for_zh: 英格兰修士，著有《英吉利教会史》，被称为“英国历史之父”。

works.title: Ecclesiastical History of the English People

people.name: Saint Boniface
people.known_for: English missionary who converted much of Germany.
people.known_for_zh: 英格兰传教士，在日耳曼地区广泛传教，被称为“德意志的使徒”。

people.name: Charles Martel
people.known_for: Frankish leader who stopped the Arab advance at Tours in 732.
people.known_for_zh: 法兰克宫相，732年在图尔战役中阻止了阿拉伯人的推进。

people.name: Paul the Deacon
people.known_for: Monk who wrote the history of the Lombards.
people.known_for_zh: 修士，著有《伦巴第人史》。

people.name: Alcuin
people.known_for: English scholar who led Charlemagne's palace school and the Carolingian Renaissance.
people.known_for_zh: 英格兰学者，主持查理曼的宫廷学校，推动加洛林文艺复兴。

Carolingian Empire.name: Charlemagne
Carolingian Empire.note: Crowned emperor by Pope Leo III on Christmas Day 800.
Carolingian Empire.note_zh: 800年圣诞节由教宗利奥三世加冕为皇帝。

Carolingian Empire.name: Lothair I
Carolingian Empire.note: The Treaty of Verdun in 843 split the empire into three.
Carolingian Empire.note_zh: 843年《凡尔登条约》将帝国一分为三。

Carolingian Empire.name: Charles the Fat
Carolingian Empire.note: Briefly reunited the empire before it broke up for good.
Carolingian Empire.note_zh: 短暂重新统一帝国，此后帝国彻底分裂。

West Francia.name: Odo
West Francia.note: Count of Paris who defended the city against the Vikings.
West Francia.note_zh: 巴黎伯爵，曾率众抵御维京人围攻巴黎。

West Francia.name: Charles the Simple
West Francia.note: Granted Normandy to the Viking Rollo in 911.
West Francia.note_zh: 911年将诺曼底封给维京首领罗洛。

East Francia.name: Henry the Fowler
East Francia.note: First king of the Saxon (Ottonian) dynasty.
East Francia.note_zh: 萨克森（奥托）王朝的第一位国王。

East Francia.name: Otto I
East Francia.note: Defeated the Magyars in 955 and was crowned emperor in 962, founding the Holy Roman Empire.
East Francia.note_zh: 955年击败马扎尔人，962年加冕称帝，神圣罗马帝国由此开始。

Byzantine Empire.name: Constantine VII
Byzantine Empire.note: Romanos I Lekapenos held power as co-emperor from 920 to 944.
Byzantine Empire.note_zh: 920年至944年由共治皇帝罗曼努斯一世掌握实权。

Byzantine Empire.name: Basil II
Byzantine Empire.note: Conquered Bulgaria; the empire was at its medieval height.
Byzantine Empire.note_zh: 征服保加利亚，帝国达到中世纪的鼎盛。

people.name: Einhard
people.known_for: Courtier who wrote the Life of Charlemagne.
people.known_for_zh: 查理曼的近臣，著有《查理大帝传》。

people.name: Rabanus Maurus
people.known_for: Abbot of Fulda called the teacher of Germany.
people.known_for_zh: 富尔达修道院院长，被称为“日耳曼的导师”。

people.name: John Scotus Eriugena
people.known_for: Irish philosopher at the court of Charles the Bald.
people.known_for_zh: 爱尔兰哲学家，在秃头查理的宫廷讲学，是中世纪早期最重要的思想家。

people.name: Cyril
people.known_for: With his brother Methodius, brought Christianity to the Slavs and created the Glagolitic script.
people.known_for_zh: 与兄长美多德一起向斯拉夫人传教，创制格拉哥里字母，西里尔字母即以其名命名。

people.name: Photios I
people.known_for: Patriarch of Constantinople and great scholar, whose clash with Rome foreshadowed the schism.
people.known_for_zh: 君士坦丁堡牧首和大学者，与罗马教廷的冲突预示了东西教会的分裂。

people.name: Rurik
people.known_for: Varangian chief who, by tradition, founded the ruling dynasty of Rus at Novgorod.
people.known_for_zh: 瓦良格首领，传说在诺夫哥罗德建立了罗斯的留里克王朝。

people.name: Alfred the Great
people.known_for: King of Wessex who held off the Danes and promoted learning in English.
people.known_for_zh: 威塞克斯国王，抵御丹麦人入侵，提倡用英语传播学问。

people.name: Simeon I
people.known_for: Tsar under whom Bulgaria became the strongest state in the Balkans.
people.known_for_zh: 保加利亚沙皇，在位期间保加利亚成为巴尔干最强国家，斯拉夫文化繁荣。

people.name: Rollo
people.known_for: Viking leader who received Normandy from the Frankish king in 911.
people.known_for_zh: 维京首领，911年从法兰克国王手中获得诺曼底。

people.name: Abd al-Rahman III
people.known_for: Made Córdoba a caliphate in 929 and the greatest city of western Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 929年在科尔多瓦自称哈里发，使其成为西欧最繁华的城市。

people.name: Olga of Kiev
people.known_for: Regent of Kyivan Rus and its first Christian ruler.
people.known_for_zh: 基辅罗斯的摄政女大公，第一位皈依基督教的罗斯统治者。

people.name: Hrotsvitha
people.known_for: German canoness, the first known woman playwright of the Middle Ages.
people.known_for_zh: 德意志修女，中世纪已知的第一位女剧作家。

check.n: Death date unknown; Wikipedia gives c. 973, other sources c. 1000/1002.
check.n_zh: 卒年不详；维基百科作约973年，另有约1000/1002年之说。

people.name: Dunstan
people.known_for: Archbishop of Canterbury who reformed English monasteries.
people.known_for_zh: 坎特伯雷大主教，推动英格兰修道院改革。

people.name: Al-Zahrawi
people.known_for: Andalusian physician called the father of modern surgery.
people.known_for_zh: 安达卢斯名医，著有外科学巨著，被称为“现代外科之父”。

people.name: Erik the Red
people.known_for: Norse explorer who founded the first settlement in Greenland.
people.known_for_zh: 北欧探险家，在格陵兰建立了第一个定居点。

people.name: Leif Erikson
people.known_for: Norse explorer who reached North America around 1000.
people.known_for_zh: 北欧探险家，约1000年到达北美洲的文兰。

people.name: Gerbert of Aurillac
people.known_for: Scholar who brought Arabic numerals and the abacus to Europe, later Pope Sylvester II.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，把阿拉伯数字和算盘引入欧洲，后成为教宗西尔维斯特二世。

people.name: Vladimir the Great
people.known_for: Prince of Kyiv who converted Rus to Orthodox Christianity in 988.
people.known_for_zh: 基辅大公，988年使罗斯皈依东正教。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Henry IV
Holy Roman Empire.note: Clashed with Pope Gregory VII and walked to Canossa in 1077.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 与教宗格里高利七世争夺主教叙任权，1077年“卡诺莎之行”。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Frederick I Barbarossa
Holy Roman Empire.note: Called Barbarossa; drowned on the Third Crusade.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 绰号“红胡子”，在第三次十字军东征途中溺亡。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Frederick II
Holy Roman Empire.note: Learned ruler of Germany and Sicily who fought the popes.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 兼治德意志和西西里的博学君主，长期与教宗对抗。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Conrad IV
Holy Roman Empire.note: After him came the Great Interregnum to 1273.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 其后为“大空位时代”，至1273年结束。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Rudolf I
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 哈布斯堡家族的第一位国王。

Kingdom of France.name: Philip II Augustus
Kingdom of France.note: Took Normandy from England and made France a great power.
Kingdom of France.note_zh: 从英格兰手中夺取诺曼底，使法国成为强国，称“奥古斯都”。

Kingdom of France.name: Louis IX
Kingdom of France.note: Led two crusades and was made a saint (Saint Louis).
Kingdom of France.note_zh: 两次率领十字军东征，死后被封为圣徒，称“圣路易”。

Kingdom of France.name: Philip IV
Kingdom of France.note: Called the Fair; humbled the papacy and destroyed the Templars.
Kingdom of France.note_zh: 绰号“美男子”，压制教廷，镇压圣殿骑士团。

England.name: Æthelred the Unready
England.note: Driven out by the Danes from 1013 to 1014.

England.name: Cnut the Great
England.note: Also king of Denmark and Norway.
England.note_zh: 同时兼任丹麦和挪威国王。

England.name: Harold II
England.note: Killed at the Battle of Hastings.
England.note_zh: 在黑斯廷斯战役中阵亡。

England.name: William the Conqueror
England.note: Duke of Normandy who conquered England in 1066.
England.note_zh: 诺曼底公爵，1066年征服英格兰。

England.name: Henry II
England.note: First Plantagenet king; ruled half of France as well.
England.note_zh: 金雀花王朝首位国王，同时领有法国的半壁江山。

England.name: Richard I
England.note_zh: 领导第三次十字军东征。

England.name: John
England.note: Forced to grant Magna Carta in 1215.

England.name: Edward I
England.note: Conquered Wales and fought the Scots.
England.note_zh: 征服威尔士，与苏格兰交战。

Byzantine Empire.name: Constantine IX Monomachos
Byzantine Empire.note: The East West Schism of 1054 came in his reign; several short reigns are left out.
Byzantine Empire.note_zh: 1054年东西教会大分裂发生在其任内，此前后数位短命皇帝从略。

Byzantine Empire.name: Romanos IV Diogenes
Byzantine Empire.note: Defeated and captured by the Seljuks at Manzikert.
Byzantine Empire.note_zh: 在曼齐刻尔特战役中被塞尔柱人击败并俘虏。

Byzantine Empire.name: Alexios I Komnenos
Byzantine Empire.note: His appeal to the West led to the First Crusade.
Byzantine Empire.note_zh: 他向西方求援，引发了第一次十字军东征。

Byzantine Empire.name: Alexios III Angelos
Byzantine Empire.note: The Fourth Crusade took Constantinople in 1204; the Greeks ruled on from Nicaea.
Byzantine Empire.note_zh: 1204年第四次十字军攻占君士坦丁堡，希腊人在尼西亚延续政权。

Byzantine Empire.name: Michael VIII Palaiologos
Byzantine Empire.note_zh: 1261年收复君士坦丁堡，建立巴列奥略王朝。

people.name: Yaroslav the Wise
people.known_for: Grand Prince under whom Kyivan Rus reached its height and gained its first law code.
people.known_for_zh: 基辅大公，在位时基辅罗斯达到鼎盛，颁布了《罗斯法典》。

people.name: Michael Psellos
people.known_for: Byzantine scholar and courtier who wrote a lively history of his times.
people.known_for_zh: 拜占庭学者和朝臣，所著《编年史》生动记述了当时的宫廷。

people.name: Pope Gregory VII
people.known_for: Reforming pope who fought Henry IV over the right to appoint bishops.
people.known_for_zh: 推行改革的教宗，与亨利四世争夺主教叙任权。

people.name: El Cid
people.known_for: Castilian knight who took Valencia and became Spain's national hero.
people.known_for_zh: 卡斯蒂利亚骑士，攻占巴伦西亚，成为西班牙的民族英雄。

people.name: Pope Urban II
people.known_for: Pope who called the First Crusade at Clermont in 1095.
people.known_for_zh: 教宗，1095年在克莱蒙会议上号召发动第一次十字军东征。

people.name: Anselm of Canterbury
people.known_for: Archbishop who gave the ontological argument for God and began scholasticism.
people.known_for_zh: 坎特伯雷大主教，提出上帝存在的本体论证明，被称为“经院哲学之父”。

people.name: Godfrey of Bouillon
people.known_for: Leader of the First Crusade and first ruler of the Kingdom of Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 第一次十字军东征的领袖，耶路撒冷王国的首位统治者。

people.name: Anna Komnene
people.known_for: Byzantine princess who wrote the history of her father Alexios I.
people.known_for_zh: 拜占庭公主，为父亲阿历克塞一世撰写传记史书。

people.name: Peter Abelard
people.known_for: Brilliant Paris teacher of logic, famous also for his love for Heloise.
people.known_for_zh: 巴黎的逻辑学家和神学家，以与爱洛依丝的爱情故事闻名。

people.name: Heloise
people.known_for: Learned abbess known for her letters to Abelard.
people.known_for_zh: 博学的女修道院院长，以与阿伯拉尔的往来书信闻名。

people.name: Bernard of Clairvaux
people.known_for: Cistercian abbot who preached the Second Crusade.
people.known_for_zh: 熙笃会修道院院长，鼓动第二次十字军东征。

people.name: Hildegard of Bingen
people.known_for: Abbess, mystic, composer and writer on medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 德意志女修道院院长，神秘主义者、作曲家，并著有医学著作。

people.name: Eleanor of Aquitaine
people.known_for: Queen of France and then of England, and mother of Richard I and John.
people.known_for_zh: 先后为法国王后和英格兰王后，狮心王理查和约翰王之母。

people.name: Chrétien de Troyes
people.known_for: French poet who shaped the Arthurian romances and the Grail story.
people.known_for_zh: 法国诗人，奠定了亚瑟王传奇和圣杯故事的基本面貌。

people.name: Averroes
people.known_for: Córdoba philosopher whose commentaries on Aristotle shaped European thought.
people.known_for_zh: 科尔多瓦的哲学家，其亚里士多德注疏对欧洲思想影响深远。

people.name: Pope Innocent III
people.known_for: Most powerful medieval pope, who called the Fourth Crusade and the Fourth Lateran Council.
people.known_for_zh: 中世纪权势最大的教宗，发动第四次十字军并召开第四次拉特兰公会议。

people.name: Fibonacci
people.known_for: Mathematician who spread Hindu Arabic numerals in Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，在欧洲推广印度阿拉伯数字，以斐波那契数列闻名。

people.name: Francis of Assisi
people.known_for: Founder of the Franciscan order, devoted to poverty and nature.
people.known_for_zh: 方济各会创始人，倡导守贫，热爱自然万物。

people.name: Saint Dominic
people.known_for: Founder of the Dominican order of preachers.
people.known_for_zh: 多明我会（布道兄弟会）的创始人。

people.name: Snorri Sturluson
people.known_for: Icelandic writer who recorded Norse myths and the sagas of Norway's kings.
people.known_for_zh: 冰岛作家，记录了北欧神话和挪威列王的萨迦。

people.name: Robert Grosseteste
people.known_for: Bishop and scholar who stressed experiment and optics.
people.known_for_zh: 主教和学者，重视实验和光学，影响了牛津的科学传统。

people.name: Alexander Nevsky
people.known_for: Prince of Novgorod who beat the Swedes and the Teutonic Knights.
people.known_for_zh: 诺夫哥罗德王公，先后击败瑞典人和条顿骑士团。

people.name: Simon de Montfort
people.known_for: Led the barons against Henry III and called an early parliament in 1265.
people.known_for_zh: 领导贵族反对亨利三世，1265年召集了早期的议会。

people.name: Albertus Magnus
people.known_for: Dominican scholar of theology and natural science, teacher of Aquinas.
people.known_for_zh: 多明我会学者，精通神学和自然科学，阿奎那的老师。

people.name: Thomas Aquinas
people.known_for: Theologian who joined Aristotle's philosophy with Christian faith.
people.known_for_zh: 神学家，将亚里士多德哲学与基督教信仰相结合，经院哲学的集大成者。

people.name: Roger Bacon
people.known_for: Franciscan friar who urged experiment as the path to knowledge.
people.known_for_zh: 方济各会修士，主张以实验获取知识，被视为实验科学的先驱。

people.name: William Wallace
people.known_for: Scottish leader who beat the English at Stirling Bridge in 1297.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格兰民族英雄，1297年在斯特灵桥战役中击败英军。

France.name: Charles IV
France.note: Last of the direct Capetians.
France.note_zh: 卡佩王朝直系的最后一位国王。

France.name: Philip VI
France.note: First Valois king; the Hundred Years' War began in 1337.
France.note_zh: 瓦卢瓦王朝首位国王，1337年百年战争爆发。

France.name: John II
France.note: Captured by the English at Poitiers in 1356.
France.note_zh: 1356年在普瓦捷战役中被英军俘虏。

France.name: Charles V
France.note: Called the Wise; won back most lost lands.
France.note_zh: 绰号“英明者”，收复了大部分失地。

France.name: Charles VII
France.note: Crowned at Reims with Joan of Arc's help; won the war in 1453.
France.note_zh: 在贞德帮助下于兰斯加冕，1453年赢得百年战争。

England.name: Edward III
England.note: Claimed the French crown, starting the Hundred Years' War.
England.note_zh: 宣称拥有法国王位，引发百年战争。

England.name: Henry VI
England.note: Lost France; the Wars of the Roses followed.
England.note_zh: 失去法国领地，随后爆发玫瑰战争。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Charles IV
Holy Roman Empire.note: Issued the Golden Bull of 1356 and made Prague his capital.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 1356年颁布《金玺诏书》，以布拉格为都城。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Sigismund
Holy Roman Empire.note: Called the Council of Constance, which ended the Western Schism.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 召开康斯坦茨公会议，结束了西方教会大分裂。

Grand Duchy of Moscow.name: Ivan I Kalita
Grand Duchy of Moscow.note: Collected tribute for the Golden Horde and raised Moscow's power.
Grand Duchy of Moscow.note_zh: 替金帐汗国征收贡赋，使莫斯科崛起，绰号“钱袋”。

Grand Duchy of Moscow.name: Dmitry Donskoy
Grand Duchy of Moscow.note: Beat the Mongols at Kulikovo in 1380.
Grand Duchy of Moscow.note_zh: 1380年在库利科沃战役中击败蒙古军队。

people.name: Dante Alighieri
people.known_for: Florentine poet of the Divine Comedy, which made Tuscan the literary language of Italy.
people.known_for_zh: 佛罗伦萨诗人，所著《神曲》使托斯卡纳方言成为意大利文学语言。

people.name: Giotto
people.known_for: Painter who broke with Byzantine style and opened the way to the Renaissance.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，突破拜占庭画风，开文艺复兴绘画之先河。

works.title: Scrovegni Chapel frescoes
works.title_zh: 斯克罗维尼礼拜堂壁画

people.name: Meister Eckhart
people.known_for: German Dominican mystic who preached the union of the soul with God.
people.known_for_zh: 德意志多明我会神秘主义者，宣讲灵魂与上帝的合一。

people.name: William of Ockham
people.known_for: Franciscan philosopher known for Ockham's razor.
people.known_for_zh: 方济各会哲学家，以“奥卡姆剃刀”原则闻名。

people.name: Petrarch
people.known_for: Poet and scholar called the father of humanism.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和学者，被称为“人文主义之父”，以写给劳拉的十四行诗著称。

people.name: Cola di Rienzo
people.known_for: Popular leader who tried to restore the Roman Republic in 1347.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马平民领袖，1347年试图恢复罗马共和国。

people.name: Giovanni Boccaccio
people.known_for: Wrote the Decameron, a hundred tales told during the Black Death.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，所著《十日谈》讲述了黑死病期间的一百个故事。

people.name: Nicole Oresme
people.known_for: Scholar who wrote on money, motion and the Earth's rotation.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，论述了货币、运动以及地球自转的可能性。

people.name: Edward the Black Prince
people.known_for: English prince who won at Poitiers in 1356.
people.known_for_zh: 英格兰王子，1356年在普瓦捷战役中俘虏法王。

people.name: Bertrand du Guesclin
people.known_for: French constable who drove the English out of much of France.
people.known_for_zh: 法国陆军统帅，把英军逐出法国大部分地区。

people.name: John Wycliffe
people.known_for: Oxford reformer behind the first English Bible.
people.known_for_zh: 牛津的宗教改革先驱，主持将《圣经》译成英文。

people.name: Sergius of Radonezh
people.known_for: Russian monk who founded the Trinity Lavra and blessed the fight against the Mongols.
people.known_for_zh: 俄罗斯修士，创建圣三一修道院，支持抗击蒙古。

people.name: Catherine of Siena
people.known_for: Mystic who urged the pope to return from Avignon to Rome.
people.known_for_zh: 神秘主义者，劝说教宗从阿维尼翁迁回罗马。

people.name: Jean Froissart
people.known_for: Chronicler of the Hundred Years' War.
people.known_for_zh: 编年史家，记述了百年战争的历史。

people.name: Geoffrey Chaucer
people.known_for: Father of English literature, author of the Canterbury Tales.
people.known_for_zh: 英国文学之父，著有《坎特伯雷故事集》。

people.name: Christine de Pizan
people.known_for: Court writer who defended women in the City of Ladies.
people.known_for_zh: 宫廷女作家，在《妇女城》中为女性辩护。

works.title: The Book of the City of Ladies

people.name: Jan Hus
people.known_for: Czech reformer burned at the Council of Constance.
people.known_for_zh: 捷克宗教改革家，在康斯坦茨公会议上被处以火刑。

people.name: Jan Žižka
people.known_for: Hussite general who never lost a battle.
people.known_for_zh: 胡斯派军事统帅，以战车堡垒战术著称，从未战败。

people.name: Andrei Rublev
people.known_for: Greatest Russian icon painter.
people.known_for_zh: 俄罗斯最伟大的圣像画家，代表作《三位一体》。

people.name: Joan of Arc
people.known_for: Peasant girl who lifted the siege of Orléans in 1429 and was burned by the English.
people.known_for_zh: 农家少女，1429年解奥尔良之围，后被英国人烧死。

people.name: Henry the Navigator
people.known_for: Portuguese prince who sponsored voyages down the African coast.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙王子，资助沿非洲海岸南下的航海探险。

people.name: Filippo Brunelleschi
people.known_for: Architect who built the dome of Florence Cathedral and worked out linear perspective.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，建造了佛罗伦萨大教堂穹顶，发现了线性透视法。

people.name: Lorenzo Ghiberti
people.known_for: Sculptor of the bronze doors of the Florence Baptistery, called the Gates of Paradise.
people.known_for_zh: 雕塑家，制作佛罗伦萨洗礼堂铜门，被誉为“天堂之门”。

people.name: Donatello
people.known_for: Sculptor whose bronze David was the first free-standing nude since antiquity.
people.known_for_zh: 雕塑家，其青铜《大卫》是古代以来第一件独立裸体雕像。

people.name: Masaccio
people.known_for: Painter who first used perspective fully in his frescoes.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，率先在壁画中全面运用透视法。

people.name: Jan van Eyck
people.known_for: Flemish painter who perfected oil painting.
people.known_for_zh: 尼德兰画家，完善了油画技法。

people.name: Fra Angelico
people.known_for: Friar painter of luminous religious frescoes.
people.known_for_zh: 修士画家，以明净的宗教壁画著称。

people.name: Cosimo de' Medici
people.known_for: Banker who ruled Florence and patronised Renaissance artists and scholars.
people.known_for_zh: 银行家，实际统治佛罗伦萨，大力资助文艺复兴的艺术家和学者。

people.name: Lorenzo Valla
people.known_for: Humanist who proved the Donation of Constantine a forgery.
people.known_for_zh: 人文主义者，证明《君士坦丁赠礼》是伪造的。

France.name: Louis XI
France.note: United most of France under the crown.
France.note_zh: 把法国大部分地区统一在王权之下。

France.name: Charles VIII
France.note: Invaded Italy in 1494, starting the Italian Wars.
France.note_zh: 1494年入侵意大利，引发意大利战争。

Castille.name: Isabella I
Castille.note: With her husband Ferdinand II of Aragon, took Granada and sent Columbus in 1492.
Castille.note_zh: 与丈夫阿拉贡国王斐迪南二世共治，1492年攻克格拉纳达并资助哥伦布。

Castille.name: Ferdinand II
Castille.note: King of Aragon, co-ruler of Castile with Isabella; regent of Castile from 1507 to 1516.
Castille.note_zh: 阿拉贡国王，与伊莎贝拉共治卡斯蒂利亚，1507年至1516年为摄政。

Castille.name: Joanna
Castille.note: Called the Mad; held the title while others ruled.
Castille.note_zh: 绰号“疯女”，仅有名义，实权在他人手中。

Castille.name: Charles I
Castille.note: Also Holy Roman Emperor as Charles V.
Castille.note_zh: 同时为神圣罗马皇帝查理五世。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Maximilian I
Holy Roman Empire.note: His marriages made the Habsburgs heirs to Burgundy and Spain.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 通过联姻使哈布斯堡家族获得勃艮第和西班牙的继承权。

Grand Duchy of Moscow.name: Ivan III
Grand Duchy of Moscow.note: Ended Mongol overlordship in 1480 and united the Russian lands.
Grand Duchy of Moscow.note_zh: 1480年摆脱蒙古统治，统一了俄罗斯各地，称“伊凡大帝”。

people.name: Johannes Gutenberg
people.known_for: Invented printing with movable metal type and printed the Gutenberg Bible.
people.known_for_zh: 发明金属活字印刷机，印制了《古腾堡圣经》。

people.name: Mehmed II
people.known_for: Ottoman sultan who conquered Constantinople in 1453.
people.known_for_zh: 奥斯曼苏丹，1453年攻陷君士坦丁堡，称“征服者”。

people.name: Skanderbeg
people.known_for: Albanian leader who resisted the Ottomans for 25 years.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔巴尼亚民族英雄，抵抗奥斯曼帝国长达25年。

people.name: Piero della Francesca
people.name_zh: 皮耶罗·德拉·弗朗切斯卡
people.known_for: Painter and mathematician of calm, geometric compositions.
people.known_for_zh: 画家和数学家，画面宁静而富于几何秩序。

people.name: Andrea Mantegna
people.known_for: Painter known for bold foreshortening and classical learning.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，以大胆的透视缩短法和古典修养著称。

people.name: Matthias Corvinus
people.known_for: Renaissance king of Hungary with a great library and standing army.
people.known_for_zh: 匈牙利文艺复兴时代的国王，建立黑军和著名的科尔维纳图书馆。

people.name: François Villon
people.known_for: Vagabond poet of late medieval Paris.
people.known_for_zh: 中世纪晚期巴黎的流浪诗人。

people.name: Marsilio Ficino
people.known_for: Translated Plato into Latin and led the Platonic Academy of Florence.
people.known_for_zh: 将柏拉图全集译成拉丁文，主持佛罗伦萨柏拉图学园。

people.name: Lorenzo de' Medici
people.known_for: Ruler of Florence and great patron of Renaissance art, called the Magnificent.
people.known_for_zh: 佛罗伦萨统治者，文艺复兴艺术的大赞助人，人称“伟大的洛伦佐”。

people.name: Sandro Botticelli
people.known_for: Florentine painter of the Birth of Venus and Primavera.
people.known_for_zh: 佛罗伦萨画家，代表作《维纳斯的诞生》和《春》。

people.name: Hieronymus Bosch
people.known_for: Netherlandish painter of fantastic visions of heaven and hell.
people.known_for_zh: 尼德兰画家，以描绘天堂与地狱的奇幻画面著称。

people.name: Girolamo Savonarola
people.known_for: Friar who ruled Florence briefly and held the Bonfire of the Vanities.
people.known_for_zh: 多明我会修士，一度主宰佛罗伦萨，焚烧“虚荣之物”，后被处死。

people.name: Pico della Mirandola
people.known_for: Humanist whose Oration on the Dignity of Man praised human freedom.
people.known_for_zh: 人文主义者，所著《论人的尊严》颂扬人的自由意志。

works.title: Oration on the Dignity of Man

people.name: Antonio de Nebrija
people.known_for: Wrote the first grammar of Castilian Spanish in 1492.
people.known_for_zh: 人文主义学者，1492年写成第一部西班牙语语法。

people.name: Aldus Manutius
people.known_for: Venetian printer of Greek classics who invented italic type.
people.known_for_zh: 威尼斯出版商，印行希腊古典著作，发明了斜体字。

people.name: Leonardo da Vinci
people.known_for: Painter, inventor and scientist, the model of the Renaissance man.
people.known_for_zh: 画家、发明家和科学家，文艺复兴“全才”的典范。

people.name: Christopher Columbus
people.known_for: Genoese navigator who reached the Americas for Spain in 1492.
people.known_for_zh: 热那亚航海家，1492年为西班牙航行到达美洲。

people.name: Bartolomeu Dias
people.known_for: Portuguese navigator who rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙航海家，1488年绕过好望角。

people.name: John Cabot
people.known_for: Venetian navigator who reached Newfoundland for England in 1497.
people.known_for_zh: 威尼斯航海家，1497年为英格兰航行到达纽芬兰。

people.name: Amerigo Vespucci
people.known_for: Navigator who saw the Americas as a New World, which was named after him.
people.known_for_zh: 航海家，认识到美洲是“新大陆”，美洲因他而得名。

people.name: Vasco da Gama
people.known_for: Portuguese navigator who opened the sea route to India in 1498.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙航海家，1498年开辟了通往印度的新航路。

people.name: Donato Bramante
people.known_for: Architect who drew the first plan for the new Saint Peter's Basilica.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，设计了新圣彼得大教堂的最初方案。

people.name: Cesare Borgia
people.known_for: Son of Pope Alexander VI and the model for Machiavelli's Prince.
people.known_for_zh: 教宗亚历山大六世之子，马基雅维利《君主论》的原型之一。

people.name: Albrecht Dürer
people.known_for: German painter and engraver who brought the Renaissance north of the Alps.
people.known_for_zh: 德意志画家和版画家，把文艺复兴带到阿尔卑斯山以北。

people.name: Michelangelo
people.known_for: Sculptor of David and painter of the Sistine Chapel ceiling.
people.known_for_zh: 雕塑家和画家，作有《大卫》和西斯廷礼拜堂天顶画。

people.name: Raphael
people.known_for: Painter of harmony and grace, known for the School of Athens.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，作品和谐优美，代表作《雅典学院》和众多圣母像。

people.name: Niccolò Machiavelli
people.known_for: Florentine official whose Prince founded modern political science.
people.known_for_zh: 佛罗伦萨官员，所著《君主论》开创了近代政治学。

people.name: Erasmus
people.known_for: Leading humanist who mocked church abuses and edited the Greek New Testament.
people.known_for_zh: 人文主义领袖，讽刺教会弊端，校订希腊文《新约》。

people.name: Thomas More
people.known_for: English statesman who wrote Utopia and was executed by Henry VIII.
people.known_for_zh: 英国政治家，著有《乌托邦》，后被亨利八世处死。

Spain.name: Charles I
Spain.note: Also Holy Roman Emperor as Charles V.
Spain.note_zh: 同时为神圣罗马皇帝查理五世。

Spain.name: Philip II
Spain.note: Ruled Spain at its height; his Armada failed against England in 1588.
Spain.note_zh: 西班牙鼎盛时期的国王，1588年“无敌舰队”远征英国失败。

France.name: Francis I
France.note: Patron of Leonardo and rival of Charles V.
France.note_zh: 列奥纳多的赞助人，查理五世的对手。

France.name: Charles IX
France.note: The Saint Bartholomew's Day massacre of 1572 took place in his reign.
France.note_zh: 1572年发生“圣巴托洛缪之夜”大屠杀。

France.name: Henry IV
France.note: First Bourbon king; the Edict of Nantes of 1598 ended the Wars of Religion.
France.note_zh: 波旁王朝首位国王，1598年颁布《南特敕令》，结束宗教战争。

France.name: Louis XIII
France.note: Cardinal Richelieu ran the government.
France.note_zh: 由黎塞留枢机主政。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Charles V
Holy Roman Empire.note: Ruled Spain, the Netherlands, Austria and the Americas; faced Luther at Worms in 1521.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 统治西班牙、尼德兰、奥地利和美洲，1521年在沃尔姆斯会议上面对路德。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Rudolf II
Holy Roman Empire.note: Patron of Tycho Brahe and Kepler in Prague.
Holy Roman Empire.note_zh: 在布拉格资助第谷和开普勒。

Holy Roman Empire.name: Ferdinand II
Holy Roman Empire.note: The Thirty Years' War began in 1618.

Holy Roman Empire.name: Ferdinand III
Holy Roman Empire.note: Made the Peace of Westphalia in 1648.

England and Ireland.name: Henry VIII
England and Ireland.note: Broke with Rome and made himself head of the Church of England.
England and Ireland.note_zh: 与罗马教廷决裂，自任英格兰教会首脑。

England and Ireland.name: Mary I
England and Ireland.note_zh: 恢复天主教，迫害新教徒，人称“血腥玛丽”。

England and Ireland.name: Elizabeth I
England and Ireland.note: Defeated the Spanish Armada; the age of Shakespeare.
England and Ireland.note_zh: 击败西班牙无敌舰队，莎士比亚的时代。

England and Ireland.name: James I
England and Ireland.note: Also King of Scotland as James VI, uniting the two crowns.
England and Ireland.note_zh: 同时为苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世，实现两国共主。

England and Ireland.name: Charles I
England and Ireland.note: Fought Parliament in the Civil War from 1642.

people.name: Martin Luther
people.known_for: Began the Reformation with his 95 Theses in 1517 and translated the Bible into German.
people.known_for_zh: 1517年发表《九十五条论纲》，掀起宗教改革，并把《圣经》译成德文。

people.name: Huldrych Zwingli
people.known_for: Leader of the Reformation in Zurich.
people.known_for_zh: 苏黎世宗教改革的领袖。

people.name: Ferdinand Magellan
people.known_for: Led the first voyage round the world, completed after his death in 1522.
people.known_for_zh: 率领船队完成首次环球航行，本人在途中战死，船队于1522年返回。

people.name: Nicolaus Copernicus
people.known_for: Astronomer who placed the Sun at the centre of the universe.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，提出日心说，引发天文学革命。

works.title: On the Revolutions of the Heavenly Spheres

people.name: François Rabelais
people.known_for: French humanist author of the comic giants Gargantua and Pantagruel.
people.known_for_zh: 法国人文主义作家，以巨人故事讽刺社会。

people.name: Ignatius of Loyola
people.known_for: Spanish founder of the Jesuit order.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙人，创立耶稣会，推动天主教改革。

people.name: Andreas Vesalius
people.known_for: Founder of modern anatomy based on dissection.
people.known_for_zh: 以人体解剖为基础，开创了近代解剖学。

people.name: John Calvin
people.known_for: French reformer who made Geneva a Protestant model city.
people.known_for_zh: 法国宗教改革家，把日内瓦建成新教的模范城市，提出预定论。

people.name: Titian
people.known_for: Leading painter of Venice, master of colour.
people.known_for_zh: 威尼斯画派的领袖，以用色著称。

people.name: Pieter Bruegel the Elder
people.known_for: Flemish painter of peasant life and landscapes.
people.known_for_zh: 尼德兰画家，以描绘农民生活和风景著称。

people.name: Gerardus Mercator
people.known_for: Cartographer who made the map projection still used for navigation.
people.known_for_zh: 地图学家，创制了至今仍用于航海的墨卡托投影。

people.name: Ivan the Terrible
people.known_for: First Tsar of Russia, who conquered Kazan and ruled through terror.
people.known_for_zh: 俄国第一位沙皇，征服喀山汗国，以恐怖手段统治，人称“伊凡雷帝”。

people.name: William the Silent
people.known_for: Led the Dutch revolt against Spain.
people.known_for_zh: 领导尼德兰反抗西班牙的起义，被尊为荷兰国父。

people.name: Michel de Montaigne
people.known_for: Created the essay as a form for exploring the self.
people.known_for_zh: 法国作家，开创了随笔这一文体。

people.name: Francis Drake
people.known_for: English captain who sailed round the world and fought the Armada.
people.known_for_zh: 英国船长，完成环球航行，参与击败西班牙无敌舰队。

people.name: Tycho Brahe
people.known_for: Danish astronomer who made the most exact observations before the telescope.
people.known_for_zh: 丹麦天文学家，留下望远镜发明前最精确的天文观测数据。

people.name: Giordano Bruno
people.known_for: Philosopher of an infinite universe, burned for heresy in Rome.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，主张宇宙无限，在罗马被以异端罪烧死。

people.name: El Greco
people.known_for: Cretan-born painter of elongated, visionary figures in Toledo.
people.known_for_zh: 生于克里特岛，在托莱多作画，人物造型修长而富于幻想。

works.title: The Burial of the Count of Orgaz

people.name: Miguel de Cervantes
people.known_for: Spanish author of Don Quixote, often called the first modern novel.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙作家，所著《堂吉诃德》常被视为第一部现代小说。

people.name: William Shakespeare
people.known_for: The greatest playwright in English.
people.known_for_zh: 英国最伟大的剧作家和诗人。

people.name: Francis Bacon
people.known_for: Philosopher who argued for science based on experiment and induction.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，倡导以实验和归纳法为基础的科学，提出“知识就是力量”。

people.name: Johannes Kepler
people.known_for: Found the three laws of planetary motion.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，发现行星运动三定律。

people.name: Galileo Galilei
people.known_for: Used the telescope to support Copernicus and founded modern physics, tried by the Inquisition.
people.known_for_zh: 用望远镜支持日心说，奠定近代物理学基础，后受宗教裁判所审判。

works.title: Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems
works.title_zh: 关于两大世界体系的对话

people.name: William Harvey
people.known_for: Showed that the blood circulates, pumped by the heart.
people.known_for_zh: 医生，发现了血液循环。

people.name: Claudio Monteverdi
people.known_for: Composer whose Orfeo is one of the first great operas.
people.known_for_zh: 作曲家，其《奥菲欧》是最早的伟大歌剧之一。

people.name: Peter Paul Rubens
people.known_for: Flemish master of the Baroque.
people.known_for_zh: 佛兰德斯画家，巴洛克艺术大师。

people.name: Cardinal Richelieu
people.known_for: Chief minister of Louis XIII who built royal absolutism.
people.known_for_zh: 路易十三的首相，加强王权，奠定法国专制主义基础。

people.name: Gustavus Adolphus
people.known_for: King of Sweden who saved the Protestant cause in the Thirty Years' War.
people.known_for_zh: 瑞典国王，在三十年战争中挽救了新教阵营，战死于吕岑。

people.name: Hugo Grotius
people.known_for: Dutch jurist called the father of international law.
people.known_for_zh: 荷兰法学家，被称为“国际法之父”。

works.title: On the Law of War and Peace

people.name: René Descartes
people.known_for: Philosopher of 'I think, therefore I am' and inventor of analytic geometry.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家和数学家，提出“我思故我在”，创立解析几何。

Austrian Empire.name_zh: 哈布斯堡君主国（奥地利）

France.name: Louis XIV
France.note: The Sun King, who built Versailles.
France.note_zh: “太阳王”，修建凡尔赛宫，是专制君主的典型。

England and Ireland.name: Oliver Cromwell
England and Ireland.note: England was a republic from 1649 to 1660.

England and Ireland.name: William III
England and Ireland.note: Ruled jointly with Mary II until 1694; accepted the Bill of Rights.
England and Ireland.note_zh: 1694年前与玛丽二世共治，接受《权利法案》。

England and Ireland.name: Anne
England and Ireland.note: England and Scotland united as Great Britain in 1707.
England and Ireland.note_zh: 1707年英格兰与苏格兰合并为大不列颠王国。

England and Ireland.name: George III
England and Ireland.note_zh: 在位期间失去北美殖民地。

Austrian Empire.name: Leopold I
Austrian Empire.note: Turned back the Ottoman siege of Vienna in 1683.
Austrian Empire.note_zh: 1683年击退奥斯曼军队对维也纳的围攻。

Austrian Empire.name: Maria Theresa
Austrian Empire.note: Ruled the Habsburg lands; her husband Francis I and then son Joseph II were emperors.
Austrian Empire.note_zh: 统治哈布斯堡领地，丈夫弗朗茨一世和儿子约瑟夫二世先后为皇帝。

Austrian Empire.name: Joseph II
Austrian Empire.note_zh: 推行开明专制改革，1765年起为皇帝。

Tsardom of Muscovy.name: Alexis
Tsardom of Muscovy.name_zh: 阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇

Tsardom of Muscovy.name: Peter the Great
Tsardom of Muscovy.note: Westernised Russia and founded Saint Petersburg.
Tsardom of Muscovy.note_zh: 推行西化改革，建立圣彼得堡，人称“彼得大帝”。

Tsardom of Muscovy.name: Catherine the Great
Tsardom of Muscovy.note: Expanded Russia to the Black Sea and took part in the partitions of Poland.
Tsardom of Muscovy.note_zh: 把俄国疆域扩展到黑海，参与瓜分波兰。

people.name: Diego Velázquez
people.known_for: Court painter of Philip IV, famous for Las Meninas.
people.known_for_zh: 腓力四世的宫廷画家，代表作《宫娥》。

people.name: Rembrandt
people.known_for: Dutch master of light and shadow.
people.known_for_zh: 荷兰画家，善用光影，代表作《夜巡》。

people.name: Thomas Hobbes
people.known_for: Argued that people need a strong sovereign to escape the war of all against all.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，认为人们需要强大的主权者以摆脱“一切人反对一切人的战争”。

people.name: Blaise Pascal
people.known_for: Mathematician, physicist and religious thinker.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家、物理学家和宗教思想家，提出帕斯卡定律。

people.name: Molière
people.known_for: Greatest French comic playwright.
people.known_for_zh: 法国最伟大的喜剧作家。

people.name: Johannes Vermeer
people.known_for: Dutch painter of quiet domestic scenes.
people.known_for_zh: 荷兰画家，擅长描绘宁静的室内生活场景。

people.name: Baruch Spinoza
people.known_for: Dutch philosopher who identified God with nature.
people.known_for_zh: 荷兰哲学家，主张“神即自然”。

people.name: Jean Racine
people.known_for: Master of French classical tragedy.
people.known_for_zh: 法国古典主义悲剧大师。

people.name: Robert Boyle
people.known_for: Pioneer of modern chemistry and Boyle's law of gases.
people.known_for_zh: 近代化学的奠基人之一，发现波义耳定律。

people.name: John Locke
people.known_for: Philosopher of natural rights and government by consent.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，提出天赋人权和政府须经被统治者同意的思想。

people.name: Isaac Newton
people.known_for: Set out the laws of motion and universal gravitation.
people.known_for_zh: 提出运动三定律和万有引力定律，发明微积分。

people.name: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz
people.known_for: Philosopher and mathematician who invented calculus alongside Newton.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家和数学家，与牛顿各自发明微积分，提出单子论。

people.name: Daniel Defoe
people.known_for: Author of Robinson Crusoe.
people.known_for_zh: 英国作家，著有《鲁滨逊漂流记》。

people.name: Jonathan Swift
people.known_for: Irish satirist, author of Gulliver's Travels.
people.known_for_zh: 爱尔兰讽刺作家，著有《格列佛游记》。

people.name: Johann Sebastian Bach
people.known_for: Baroque composer, master of counterpoint.
people.known_for_zh: 巴洛克作曲家，复调音乐大师，被称为“音乐之父”。

people.name: George Frideric Handel
people.known_for: German-born composer in London, famed for Messiah.
people.known_for_zh: 生于德意志、定居伦敦的作曲家，代表作清唱剧《弥赛亚》。

people.name: Montesquieu
people.known_for: Proposed the separation of powers.
people.known_for_zh: 启蒙思想家，提出三权分立学说。

people.name: Voltaire
people.known_for: Leading Enlightenment writer who fought for tolerance and free speech.
people.known_for_zh: 启蒙运动的领袖，为宗教宽容和言论自由而斗争。

people.name: Carl Linnaeus
people.known_for: Swedish botanist who created the two-name system for naming species.
people.known_for_zh: 瑞典植物学家，创立生物命名的双名法。

people.name: Leonhard Euler
people.known_for: Swiss mathematician, one of the most productive in history.
people.known_for_zh: 瑞士数学家，史上最多产的数学家之一。

people.name: David Hume
people.known_for: Scottish philosopher of empiricism and skepticism.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格兰哲学家，经验主义和怀疑论的代表。

people.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
people.known_for: Argued for popular sovereignty in the Social Contract.
people.known_for_zh: 启蒙思想家，在《社会契约论》中提出人民主权思想。

people.name: Denis Diderot
people.known_for: Chief editor of the Encyclopédie.
people.known_for_zh: 主编《百科全书》，百科全书派的领袖。

people.name: Frederick the Great
people.known_for: King of Prussia who made it a great power and an enlightened despot.
people.known_for_zh: 普鲁士国王，使普鲁士成为强国，开明专制君主的代表，人称“腓特烈大帝”。

people.name: Adam Smith
people.known_for: Founder of modern economics.
people.known_for_zh: 经济学家，近代经济学的奠基人，提出“看不见的手”。

people.name: Immanuel Kant
people.known_for: German philosopher who examined the limits of reason.
people.known_for_zh: 德国哲学家，考察理性的界限，德国古典哲学的创始人。

people.name: James Watt
people.known_for: Improved the steam engine, driving the Industrial Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 改良蒸汽机，推动了工业革命。

people.name: Joseph Haydn
people.known_for: Composer called the father of the symphony.
people.known_for_zh: 作曲家，被称为“交响乐之父”。

people.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
people.known_for: Child prodigy and Classical composer of operas and symphonies.
people.known_for_zh: 古典主义作曲家，神童出身，创作了大量歌剧和交响曲。

people.name: Antoine Lavoisier
people.known_for: Father of modern chemistry, who named oxygen.
people.known_for_zh: 近代化学之父，命名了氧气，提出质量守恒定律。

France.name: Louis XVI

France.note_zh: 1792年被废黜，1793年被处死，法国成为共和国。

France.name: Napoleon Bonaparte
France.note: Took power in the coup of 18 Brumaire.
France.note_zh: 通过雾月政变掌权。

France.name: Napoleon I
France.note: Returned for the Hundred Days in 1815.

people.name: Edmund Burke
people.known_for: Irish-born statesman whose attack on the French Revolution founded modern conservatism.
people.known_for_zh: 英国政治家，批判法国大革命，被视为近代保守主义之父。

people.name: Thomas Paine
people.known_for: Radical writer who defended the French Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 激进作家，为美国独立和法国大革命辩护。

people.name: Mirabeau
people.known_for: Great orator of the early Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 大革命初期最著名的演说家。

people.name: Lafayette
people.known_for: Hero of the American war who drafted the Declaration of the Rights of Man.
people.known_for_zh: 参加美国独立战争，起草法国《人权宣言》。

people.name: Maximilien Robespierre
people.known_for: Jacobin leader of the Reign of Terror, executed in 1794.
people.known_for_zh: 雅各宾派领袖，主导恐怖统治，1794年被送上断头台。

people.name: Georges Danton
people.known_for: Revolutionary leader executed during the Terror.
people.known_for_zh: 大革命领袖之一，在恐怖统治中被处死。

people.name: Jean-Paul Marat
people.known_for: Radical journalist murdered in his bath.
people.known_for_zh: 激进记者，在浴缸中遇刺身亡。

people.name: Olympe de Gouges
people.known_for: Wrote the Declaration of the Rights of Woman.
people.known_for_zh: 女作家，发表《女权与女性公民权利宣言》，后被处死。

works.title: Declaration of the Rights of Woman and of the Female Citizen

people.name: Mary Wollstonecraft
people.known_for: Early feminist philosopher.
people.known_for_zh: 早期女权主义思想家。

people.name: Jacques-Louis David
people.known_for: Neoclassical painter of the Revolution and Napoleon.
people.known_for_zh: 新古典主义画家，描绘大革命和拿破仑。

people.name: Talleyrand
people.known_for: Diplomat who served every French regime from the Revolution to 1834.
people.known_for_zh: 外交家，从大革命到七月王朝历仕各朝。

people.name: Napoleon
people.known_for: General who became emperor, conquered much of Europe and gave France its civil code.
people.known_for_zh: 军事家，称帝后征服欧洲大部，颁布《拿破仑法典》。

people.name: William Pitt the Younger
people.known_for: British prime minister at 24 who led the fight against France.
people.known_for_zh: 24岁出任英国首相，领导对法战争。

people.name: Horatio Nelson
people.known_for: British admiral killed winning the Battle of Trafalgar.
people.known_for_zh: 英国海军将领，在特拉法尔加海战中大胜并阵亡。

people.name: Mikhail Kutuzov

people.known_for_zh: 俄国元帅，1812年将拿破仑逐出俄国。

people.name: Duke of Wellington
people.known_for: British general who defeated Napoleon at Waterloo.
people.known_for_zh: 英国将领，在滑铁卢战役中击败拿破仑。

people.name: Edward Jenner

people.known_for_zh: 1796年发明牛痘接种法预防天花。

people.name: Alessandro Volta
people.known_for: Invented the electric battery in 1800.
people.known_for_zh: 1800年发明伏打电堆，即最早的电池。

people.name: Pierre-Simon Laplace
people.known_for: Mathematician of celestial mechanics and probability.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，研究天体力学和概率论，提出星云假说。

people.name: Jean-Baptiste Lamarck
people.known_for: Naturalist who proposed an early theory of evolution.
people.known_for_zh: 博物学家，提出早期的生物进化学说。

people.name: Thomas Robert Malthus
people.known_for: Warned that population grows faster than food.
people.known_for_zh: 经济学家，认为人口增长快于食物增长。

people.name: Francisco Goya
people.known_for: Spanish painter of the court and of the horrors of war.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙画家，描绘宫廷，也揭露战争的残酷。

people.name: Friedrich Schiller
people.known_for: German poet and playwright of freedom.
people.known_for_zh: 德国诗人和剧作家，作品歌颂自由。

people.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
people.known_for: Germany's greatest writer, author of Faust.
people.known_for_zh: 德国最伟大的作家，著有《浮士德》。

people.name: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
people.known_for: Philosopher of the dialectic and of history as the progress of freedom.
people.known_for_zh: 德国古典哲学的集大成者，提出辩证法体系。

people.known_for: Composer who bridged Classical and Romantic music, writing on through deafness.

people.known_for: Found the double helix of DNA with James Watson in 1953.
people.known_for_zh: 1953年与沃森发现DNA双螺旋结构。

people.name: Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn
people.known_for: Exposed the Soviet labour camps.
people.known_for_zh: 揭露苏联劳改营，1970年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Andrei Sakharov
people.known_for: Physicist of the Soviet H-bomb who became a dissident.
people.known_for_zh: 苏联氢弹之父，后成为人权活动家，获诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Michel Foucault
people.known_for: Philosopher of power and knowledge.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，研究权力与知识的关系。

people.name: Günter Grass
people.known_for: German novelist who confronted the Nazi past.
people.known_for_zh: 德国小说家，直面纳粹历史，1999年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Pope John Paul II
people.known_for: Polish pope who helped bring down communism in Eastern Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 波兰籍教宗，推动了东欧共产主义政权的瓦解。

people.name: John Lennon
people.known_for: Founder of the Beatles.
people.known_for_zh: 披头士乐队的创始人之一。

people.name: Umberto Eco
people.known_for: Italian semiotician and novelist.
people.known_for_zh: 意大利符号学家和小说家。

people.name: Stephen Hawking
people.known_for: Physicist of black holes.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家，研究黑洞，著有《时间简史》。

United Kingdom.name: David Cameron
United Kingdom.note: Called the 2016 referendum in which Britain voted to leave the EU.
United Kingdom.note_zh: 举行2016年脱欧公投，英国投票决定退出欧盟。

United Kingdom.name: Boris Johnson
United Kingdom.note_zh: 英国于2020年正式脱离欧盟。

people.name: Jacques Delors
people.known_for: President of the European Commission who drove the single market and the Maastricht Treaty.
people.known_for_zh: 欧盟委员会主席，推动统一大市场和《马斯特里赫特条约》。

people.name: Václav Havel
people.known_for: Playwright who led the Velvet Revolution and became Czech president.
people.known_for_zh: 剧作家，领导“天鹅绒革命”，后任捷克总统。

people.name: Wisława Szymborska
people.known_for: Polish poet, Nobel Prize 1996.
people.known_for_zh: 波兰女诗人，1996年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Seamus Heaney
people.known_for: Irish poet, Nobel Prize 1995.
people.known_for_zh: 爱尔兰诗人，1995年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: José Saramago
people.known_for: Portuguese novelist, Nobel Prize 1998.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙小说家，1998年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Imre Kertész
people.known_for: Hungarian Holocaust survivor and novelist, Nobel Prize 2002.
people.known_for_zh: 匈牙利作家，大屠杀幸存者，2002年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Zygmunt Bauman
people.known_for: Polish sociologist of liquid modernity.
people.known_for_zh: 波兰裔社会学家，提出“流动的现代性”。

people.name: Ian Wilmut
people.known_for: Led the team that cloned Dolly the sheep in 1996.
people.known_for_zh: 领导团队于1996年克隆出多莉羊。

people.name: Zaha Hadid
people.known_for: Architect of bold curving buildings.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，以大胆的曲线设计著称，首位获普利兹克奖的女性。

people.name: Anna Politkovskaya
people.name_zh: 安娜·波利特科夫斯卡娅
people.known_for: Russian journalist who reported on Chechnya and was murdered.
people.known_for_zh: 俄罗斯记者，报道车臣战争，遭暗杀。

people.name: Pope Benedict XVI
people.known_for: German pope who resigned in 2013.
people.known_for_zh: 德国籍教宗，2013年辞去教宗职务。

people.name: Pope Francis
people.known_for: First pope from the Americas, known for his care for the poor.
people.known_for_zh: 第一位来自美洲的教宗，关注贫困者和环境。

people.name: Alexei Navalny
people.known_for: Russian opposition leader who died in prison.
people.known_for_zh: 俄罗斯反对派领袖，死于狱中。

people.name: Peter Higgs
people.known_for: Predicted the Higgs boson, found at CERN in 2012.
people.known_for_zh: 预言希格斯玻色子，2012年在欧洲核子研究中心被发现。
